editorial_workflow.subtitle: Files, releases and recordings are different
editorial_workflow.description: Preserve both files first. Compare their origins, version labels and audio at matching passages. Separate file identity from recording identity, and keep an unresolved pair rather than making a deletion decision from a title, duration or tag alone.
